stories.name: Qualcomm-Amazon AI Chip Deal
stories.blurb: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation partnership to develop custom AI data center chips, sending Qualcomm's stock sharply higher.

stories.name: Amazon delivery expansion
stories.blurb: Amazon is rapidly expanding and restructuring its delivery and logistics network, from same-day delivery partnerships and rail service to drone expansion, while facing job cuts and antitrust lawsuits

stories.name: Big Tech AI cloud race
stories.blurb: Tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle are seeing soaring cloud growth driven by AI, prompting investors to debate which stock is the best buy.

stories.name: Anthropic IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic is preparing for a massive IPO, meeting investors, expanding its banking and credit lineup, and structuring founder control while launching new models and chip efforts.

stories.name: Amazon Q2 Earnings
stories.blurb: Amazon's stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, driven by AWS growth and heavy investment, spark a stock rally and debate over whether shares remain a buy.

stories.name: Musk Delta Starlink feud
stories.blurb: Elon Musk is publicly feuding with Delta Air Lines and its CEO Ed Bastian over the airline's refusal to adopt Starlink Wi-Fi, while rivals United and American move to poach Delta customers.

stories.name: Amazon AI spending surge
stories.blurb: Amazon is dramatically ramping up capital spending on AI and cloud infrastructure, raising investor concerns about the scale of its cash burn even as it reports strong demand for AWS capacity.

stories.name: AI data center selloff
stories.blurb: Investors are selling off AI data center and hyperscaler stocks amid political uncertainty and doubts about the economics of massive infrastructure spending.

past.name: Apple Smart Home Push
past.blurb: Apple is launching a new lineup of smart home devices and partnerships to challenge Amazon and Google in the smart home market.

past.name: Amazon timekeeping change
past.blurb: Amazon is changing how time works, affecting timekeeping globally.

past.name: Amazon Qualcomm AI deal
past.blurb: Amazon is partnering with Qualcomm on AI data-center chips, boosting Qualcomm's stock and validating its data-center pivot.

past.name: Meta Muse vs Amazon
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI shopping agent is integrating with Shopify, PayPal, and Shop Pay to challenge Amazon, which is moving to block the rival AI checkout tool from its platform, sparking market reaction

past.name: Amazon ecosystem expansion
past.blurb: A wave of companies are announcing new executive hires, certifications, and platform integrations aimed at serving brands and retailers selling across Amazon and other major marketplaces.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Picks
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold major tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle amid AI-driven market shifts.

7.text: Amazon expanded custom AI chip commitments over 20-fold and will offer Trainium outside AWS in late 2027; Qualcomm signed an AI data center product deal with Amazon. Amazon's $2 billion Ohio data center faces a local vote, and its Talen Energy power contract ramps up.

4.text: Amazon settled an Arizona Prime cancellation case, replaced GrubHub with Uber Eats for restaurant delivery, blocked Meta's shopping agent, opened free product feeds to outside stores, tested Alexa shopping, and cut more October jobs. It also launched a $25 Thanksgiving meal deal and issued Prime refunds up to $200 to some members.

6.text: Alphabet and Microsoft face investor scrutiny over massive AI capital expenditures, with Alphabet losing $500 billion in market value after earnings and Microsoft beating estimates yet trading below year-ago levels. Amazon is mentioned only as one of several hyperscalers Wall Street has turned bearish on.

8.text: Anthropic filed for an IPO at a reported $1.5–2 trillion valuation, showing ~$16–17B revenue, a $567M operating loss, and $895B in compute commitments. Investors and Michael Burry question the pricing and accounting, while Amazon stands to gain as a major cloud partner and backer.

5.text: Amazon’s Q3 revenue hit $201.94B with a record 13.9% operating margin and 61% operating income growth, while AWS revenue surged 39% to $46B, its fastest in years. The stock fell or barely moved after earnings despite the beat, as investors weighed heavy AI capital spending.

13.text: Tesla and SpaceX joined companies objecting to NYSE parent ICE's new plan, while China Renaissance initiated SpaceX coverage with a Buy rating and $194.20 target. Ark bought 348,406 SpaceX shares worth $47.4 million and trimmed Alphabet again. Amazon isn't mentioned; the story doesn't bear on it.

16.text: Amazon plans to spend up to half a trillion dollars annually on AI, per JPMorgan. It arranged $80 billion in secured supplier financing for tech infrastructure after a $34.8 billion quarterly free cash flow outflow.

17.text: Democratic midterm wins in Texas, Georgia, Ohio and Congress sparked an AI data center selloff, with CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN and Credo dropping over 10% on expected restrictions and higher costs. Amazon and other hyperscalers held up better, with some analysts arguing a buildout slowdown could benefit them.
